title: Finite Orders of Products of Two Class Transpositions Divide 840
summary: We prove that if the product of two class transpositions has finite order, then its order divides 840. This gives a complete affirmative answer to Question 18.48 in the Kourovka Notebook. We also obtain a criterion for the product of two class transpositions to have infinite order. In addition, we construct a pair of class transpositions whose product has order 840, showing that the bound is sharp.
